groups.label: Cost

actions.expr:
IIF(
CONTAINS(subcategory,'$[Round Double Skin Control Damper]'),
250,
IIF(CONTAINS(subcategory,'$[Round Balancing Damper]'),
150,
IIF(CONTAINS(subcategory,'$[Round Seal Stop Damper]'),
200,
0)
)
)

constraints.when:
NOT(CONTAINS(actuatorControls, '$[Modulating]')
&&
CONTAINS(actuatorBrand, '$[Belimo]')
&&
CONTAINS(actuatorPowerSupply, '$[24V]')
&&
(
( CONTAINS(actuatorType, '$[Spring Return]')
&& CONTAINS(actuatorAuxSwitch, '$[w/o Aux]')
)
||
( CONTAINS(actuatorType, '$[Fire & Smoke]','$[Spring Return]') ) )
)
&&
NOT(ISIMPORT())

CONTAINS(actuatorControls, '$[Modulating]')
&&
CONTAINS(actuatorBrand, '$[Belimo]')
&&
CONTAINS(actuatorPowerSupply, '$[24V]')
&&
(
(
CONTAINS(actuatorType, '$[Spring Return]')
&&
CONTAINS(actuatorAuxSwitch, '$[w/o Aux]')
)
||
(
CONTAINS(actuatorType, '$[Fire & Smoke]','$[Spring Return]')
)
)
CONTAINS(subcategory, '$[Round Balancing Damper]','$[Round Seal Stop Damper]')

actions.expr: 'Actuator cost not found for the given actuator input.'

IIF(
CONTAINS(subcategory,'$[Round Double Skin Control Damper]'),
'Spot Welded',
'Clinch'
)
IIF( CONTAINS(subcategory,'$[Round Double Skin Control Damper]'), 'Silicone Standard', 'None' )
IIF( CONTAINS(subcategory,'$[Round Double Skin Control Damper]'), 'Bronze Oilite', 'Nylon 6/6' )
IIF(CONTAINS(subcategory,'$[Round Balancing Damper]'),'RBD',IIF(CONTAINS(subcategory,'$[Round Seal Stop Damper]'),'RSD',IIF(CONTAINS(subcategory,'$[Round Double Skin Control Damper]'),'RDS','')))
IIF(CONTAINS(subcategory,'$[Round Balancing Damper]'),'ED',IIF(CONTAINS(subcategory,'$[Round Seal Stop Damper]'),'RD',IIF(CONTAINS(subcategory,'$[Round Double Skin Control Damper]'),'RI','')))
IIF(CONTAINS(subcategory,'$[Round Double Skin Control Damper]'),'Double Skin','Single Skin')
IIF(CONTAINS(subcategory,'$[Round Double Skin Control Damper]'),1220,IIF(CONTAINS(subcategory,'$[Round Seal Stop Damper]'),910,610))
'Frame Depth not in the limit between 200 and 1250'

constraints.when:
CONTAINS(subcategory,'$[Round Double Skin Control Damper]') 
&& (CONTAINS(velocityRating,'$[3000 fpm (15m/s)]','$[4000 fpm (20m/s)]') 
|| CONTAINS(staticPressureClass,'$[6Inch w.c (1500Pa)]'))
((NUMBER(frameDepth) < 150) || (NUMBER(frameDepth) > NUMBER(diameter)) && CONTAINS(subcategory,'$[Round Balancing Damper]','$[Round Seal Stop Damper]')

actions.expr: 'Frame Depth not in the limit between 150 and diameter'
CONCAT('Frame Thickness Must be greater than minimum Frame thickness(',OBJECTATTRIBUTEF(unique,'min_frame_thickness'),')')

constraints.when:
CONTAINS(subcategory,'$[Round Double Skin Control Damper]') 
&& 
(CONTAINS(staticPressureClass,'$[4Inch w.c. (1000Pa)]','$[6Inch w.c (1500Pa)]') || CONTAINS(velocityRating,'$[2400 fpm (12m/s)]','$[3000 fpm (15m/s)]','$[4000 fpm (20m/s)]'))

(NUMBER(diameter)>0 && COUNT(subcategory) > 0 )|| (	ISCHANGED(actuatorBrand) || ISCHANGED(actuatorType) || ISCHANGED(actuatorControls) || ISCHANGED(actuatorAuxSwitch) || ISCHANGED(actuatorPowerSupply) || ISCHANGED(actuatorFeedback))

actions.expr:
IIF(CONTAINS(materialType, '$[AL]','$[EAL]'),
CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[AL/EALDensityFactor]','cost')),
IIF(CONTAINS(materialType, '$[SS304L]','$[SS316L]'),
     CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[SS Density Factor]','cost')),
     CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[GI Density Factor]','cost'))
 ))

NUMBER(bladeSealArea)*IIF(CONTAINS(bladeSeal,'$[Silicone Standard]'),CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[Blade Seal Standard]','cost')),CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[UL FNST Blade Seal - High Temperature]','cost')))

NUMBER(bladeSealCost)
+
NUMBER(axleRoundBarCost)
+
NUMBER(axleSquarePinCost)
+
NUMBER(bushCost)
+
NUMBER(axleRetainerCost)
+
NUMBER(manualQuadrantCost)

NUMBER(frameCost)
+
NUMBER(bladeCost)
+
NUMBER(frameAccessoriesCost)
+
NUMBER(totalBladeAssembly)
+
NUMBER(motorHoldingPlateCost)
+
NUMBER(amcaLabelCost)

IIF(CONTAINS(frameClosure,'$[Fully Welded]'),
(NUMBER(frameDepth)/1000*IIF(CONTAINS(materialType,'$[GI]'),
CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[GI Welding Cost]','cost'))
,
IIF(CONTAINS(materialType,'$[AL]'),
CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[AL Welding Cost (VCDR)]','cost')),
CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[SS Welding Cost (VCDR)]','cost'))
)))
,
0)

CONCAT(
    IIF((NUMBER(diameter) > 0), CONCAT( 'D:' , NUMBER(diameter)) , ''),
    IIF((NUMBER(frameDepth) > 0), CONCAT( ' L:' , NUMBER(frameDepth)) , ''),
    IIF((COUNT(materialType) > 0), CONCAT( ' - ' ,SELECTEDVALUE(materialType)) , ''),
    ' ',
    TEXT(modelNo),
    IIF(CONTAINS(operator, '$[Motorized]'),' Motorized',''),
    ' Round Volume Control Damper'
)
